name: k8s-worker
description: kubeadm worker join for an existing gough Kubernetes control plane, airgap-capable.

config.raw.lxc:
lxc.apparmor.profile=unconfined
lxc.cap.drop=
lxc.cgroup.devices.allow=a
lxc.mount.auto=proc:rw sys:rw cgroup:rw

parameters.name: cpu_cores
parameters.description: LXD limits.cpu. Integer cores; must be >= resources.cpu_cores.min.

parameters.name: memory
parameters.description: LXD limits.memory (hard, no swap). IEC units only; must be >= resources.memory.min.

parameters.name: root_disk_size
parameters.description: Root disk size for the instance device. IEC units only; must be >= resources.root_disk.min.

parameters.name: storage_pool
parameters.description: LXD storage pool holding the root disk.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Guest hostname and Kubernetes node name. Per instance.

parameters.name: instance_name
parameters.description: LXD instance name. Per instance, so it can share a hypervisor with k8s-controller.

parameters.name: static_ip
parameters.description: Static IPv4 CIDR for eth0, e.g. 192.168.8.51/24.

parameters.name: gateway
parameters.description: Default gateway IPv4. No default.

parameters.name: dns_servers
parameters.description: Comma-separated DNS server IPv4 list.

parameters.name: join_endpoint
parameters.description: Control-plane endpoint host:port, supplied by the hub from the controller's join report.

parameters.name: join_token
parameters.description: kubeadm bootstrap token. Secret.

parameters.name: join_ca_cert_hash
parameters.description: Cluster CA public-key pin for discovery.

parameters.name: bridge
parameters.description: Host bridge the NIC attaches to.

parameters.name: image_alias
parameters.description: LXD image alias or fingerprint.

parameters.name: allow_privileged
parameters.description: Explicit opt-in for security.privileged and the unconfined AppArmor raw.lxc. Renders fail without true.

parameters.name: apt_mirror
parameters.description: Ubuntu archive mirror base URL.

parameters.name: k8s_apt_repo
parameters.description: Kubernetes apt repo for the minor line.

parameters.name: k8s_apt_key_url
parameters.description: URL of the armored Kubernetes apt signing key on the mirror.

parameters.name: k8s_apt_key_sha256
parameters.description: sha256 of the armored key file.

parameters.name: k8s_version
parameters.description: Expected kubeadm version; must match the controller.

parameters.name: k8s_package_version
parameters.description: Exact apt version for kubelet, kubeadm, kubectl.

parameters.name: containerd_package_version
parameters.description: Exact Ubuntu archive apt version for containerd (no default).

parameters.name: registry_mirror
parameters.description: Mirror registry URL serving upstream repository paths.

parameters.name: mirrored_registries
parameters.description: Upstream registries routed through registry_mirror.

parameters.name: internal_ca_url
parameters.description: Optional PEM CA for a private mirror TLS chain. Empty skips.

parameters.name: internal_ca_sha256
parameters.description: sha256 of internal_ca_url content.

parameters.name: allow_insecure_mirrors
parameters.description: Allow plain http:// for mirror URLs (airgapped labs). Logged as a warning. Default false; report_url is always https.
